models.name: Chronos-2
models.fit: Primary forecaster. Common-area and floor energy day-ahead with 10/50/90 bands. Humidity progression and water-flow forecasting with covariates (rain, temperature, schedule) through future_df. Anomaly indicator = actual outside the forecast band.
models.reason: Apache-2.0, not gated, zero-shot (no training on our data), gives 10/50/90 quantiles and accepts covariates. Runs in its own env because its transformers needs huggingface-hub<2.
models.measured_scope: BDG2 electricity, day-ahead, univariate only (20 office meters)

models.name: Chronos-Bolt-small

verifier_corrections: The HGB fallback's numbers must come from one model. The 0.766 conformal coverage belongs to an HGB trained to 2017-09-30 with an October calibration month, and that model's WAPE is 9.28% (I re-ran it). WAPE 8.87% belongs to a different HGB, trained to 2017-10-31 with no band. Write 'HGB + split-conformal: WAPE 9.28%, 80% coverage 0.766', or re-measure both from one model.

BDG2 licence: the LICENSE header reads 'Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 Unported', but the body is the CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported legal code, and GitHub detects NOASSERTION. Describe it as 'CC BY-SA (LICENSE header says 4.0 Unported; text is the 3.0 Unported legal code)' rather than plain 'CC BY-SA 4.0'. Attribution and share-alike apply either way.
Model sizes: the Chronos-2 weights are 477,930,472 bytes (478 MB, or 456 MiB). Chronos-Bolt-small is 190,888,824 bytes (191 MB, or 182 MiB). Use one unit consistently.

Zero-shot caveat: the Chronos-2 paper's Table 6 (real pretraining datasets) contains no BDG-2 subset; its only building data is the synthetic Buildings-900K. GIFT-Eval Pretrain does include bdg-2_bear, bdg-2_fox, bdg-2_panther, bdg-2_rat, bull, cockatoo and hog. 4 of the 20 pilot meters (Fox_office_Brandy, Fox_office_Susanne, Rat_office_Craig, Rat_office_Jamal) appear there with the exact Nov-Dec 2017 test-window values. Chronos-Bolt's training corpus is not stated on its card. So the note 'we did not check' is out of date. Replace it with these specifics.
'Chronos-2 beat seasonal naive on 20/20 meters' holds only for the pilot's 20 meters, 12 of which come from sites in GIFT-Eval Pretrain (Fox, Hog, Rat).
First-import time of chronos was about 28 s to 89 s in the logs (it says 30-90 s); timings were measured with other jobs running.
TimesFM 2.5: the HF safetensors metadata counts 231.3M params (the card name says 200M). MOMENT-1-large has 346M params (0.35B).
Source URLs have moved: NREL/BuildingsBench is now NatLabRockies/BuildingsBench, and microsoft/LightGBM is now lightgbm-org/LightGBM. Both redirect, and their licences are unchanged.

The 12m49s install time is probably inflated by pip.ini at three levels (ProgramData, user and roaming), which sets extra-index-url https://pypi.ngc.nvidia.com. That host fails DNS, and pip retries it 5 times per package. no-cache-dir=true is also set.
'Under 10 s' live HGB retrain was not reproduced: 13.8 s for one meter on this laptop with other jobs running.
